identity.title: Guardian Gods of the City of Water: Latias and Latios Music Collection

leadText:
Guardian Gods of the City of Water: Latias and Latios Music Collection is the original Japanese soundtrack CD of the 5th Pokémon movie, Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias. It was released in Japan on August 1, 2002.

It is referred to as "The Pokémon 2002 Music Collection" in the English credits of the movie.

==Tracklist==
 }

==Trivia==
This soundtrack was released exactly one year after the previous movie soundtrack.
Japanese fans have speculated that Coba might have redeveloped the melody of Mystery Girl, Again (Labyrinth) from some parts of his 1991 song Hana Ichiba (花市場, lit. Flower Market). 
Mystery Girl, Again (Labyrinth) was reused for the Latias Research Event in Pokémon Sleep.
